Fill-Up Log
Fill the tank each time and enter the odometer and the litres it took: litres over the distance since the last fill is what the vehicle really uses. Fuel on a route is read from the state price schemes' lists, which have no Northern Territory and miss some roadhouses - check before counting on it. Nothing here leaves the phone.

Keeps the screen on. A phone that goes dark stops recording; off saves battery when parked.

Terrain Shading
Shows which way the ground falls. Needs a connection - with no signal the map draws flat.
Map Tilt
Leans the map so you see twice as far up the road. Heading up only - N Up stays flat.
Night Map
Darkens the map at dusk so it does not dazzle. Auto follows the sun where you are; Day or Night holds until the next one.
